name: infinite-gym-center
description: Premium gym management, membership and smart booking platform for INFINITE GYM CENTER.

scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.db:generate: echo "Run: supabase gen types typescript --project-id <project-ref> > src/types/database.types.ts"
scripts.db:migrate: echo "Apply every file in supabase/migrations/ with the Supabase CLI or SQL editor."
scripts.db:seed: echo "Apply supabase/seed.sql after the migrations. All seed rows are clearly labelled DEMO DATA."
